excerpts: AHRF Definition PDF (6 pp, Jan 2026): dashboard is a subset of full county-level + national/state-level AHRF files at https://data.hrsa.gov/data/download?data=AHRF#AHRF. County and state files use different sources so county sums do NOT equal state/national counts. Release year = fiscal year of development (Oct 1-Sep 30); per-variable years differ (2024-2025 release: county MD/dentist thru 2023 AMA/ADA; county NP thru 2024 NPI; county pop thru 2024 Census; state thru 2023 ACS PUMS). Dashboard shows calendar year. CT: 9 planning regions replaced 8 counties (OMB 2022); files carry both FIPS schemes; dashboard uses 9 since 2025. County sources: AMA (MD/DO), ADA (dentists), CMS NPI/NPPES (nurses, PAs); pop: Census estimates/characteristics/SAIPE. State sources: ACS 5-Year PUMS, SOC 2018, workforce = age 16+ worked in last 5 years; suppression PRSE>30% shown NA. Clinician rate = count/pop*100000.
